h1: Wix Velo and CMS, databases and dynamic pages
overview: We use Wix CMS and Velo to make your site do more than show static pages. We design the database collections, build dynamic pages that fill from them, add search and filters, and write the Velo code for forms that save data, member-only content or custom calculations. Everything is built in your own Wix site, tested with sample records and explained so your team can add data later.

faq: Do I need to know code to manage this later?
No. Collections are edited in the Wix content manager, like a spreadsheet. We show you how to add and edit records, and the code is commented in case a developer needs to read it.
Does Velo work on every Wix site?
Velo works on Wix and Wix Studio sites, with a Premium plan needed for publishing. We check your plan and editor first and tell you plainly if something is not supported, before we start.
Can you import my existing spreadsheet?
Yes. Send a CSV or Google Sheet and we map the columns to collection fields, clean the data and import it. We check for duplicates and missing values first and send you a short list.
Is it safe to store customer data in a collection?

We set permissions so only the right people can read or write each collection, and we avoid storing sensitive data like payment details. Wix handles the hosting, and you decide the privacy wording that applies to you.
